body.title: Add the gitHooks setting row
body.summary: Add the boolean gitHooks row (default false) to the repository tracker fields and the gitHooks key to GithubEntry, and extend the settings, completeness and round-trip tests so a configuration file written with the key reads back and one without it reads false.
acceptanceChecks: repo.settings.get returns false for a repository whose entry has no gitHooks key, and repo.settings.set accepts true and false and refuses a non-boolean
A github.json written with gitHooks true reads back with it and keeps every other key
The Repos pane completeness test and the settings tests pass with the new row

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/repo-settings.test.ts: the gitHooks setting reads false when absent, is validated as a boolean and round-trips through github.json
